mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.book_name, n.content, n.visibility, n.create_time, n.update_time, COUNT(l.id) AS like_count FROM t_note n LEFT JOIN t_note_like l ON l.note_id = n.id WHERE n.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND n.audit_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY n.id ORDER BY like_count DESC, n.create_time DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_note WHERE visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND audit_status = 'APPROVED'
